name: AMC Bento Launchpad
description: A bento launchpad: list entries become tiles of mixed sizes with an oversized tilted icon, a description and a live metric, and the grid and every tile recompose with container queries as the region changes width.
useFor: Home pages and workspace launchpads with 4 to 12 entries, where each destination has a short description and a number worth showing (open orders, overdue invoices, pending approvals).
helpText: List template for a List region. User Defined Attribute 1 sets the tile size: wide (two columns), tall (two rows) or large (two by two, filled with the primary color); leave it empty for a normal tile, and other values are ignored. Attribute 2 is a short description and Attribute 3 a metric such as '128' or 'SAR 4.2M' (use an application item substitution to keep it live). The grid uses 1 column below 480px of region width (tiles become rows), 2 columns up to 760px, 4 up to 1180px and 6 beyond; tall, wide and large tiles switch their inner layout to show a big metric. While one tile has the pointer the others step back. Everything works with the keyboard in list order, with a visible focus ring. Template options: Tinted tiles, Compact rows, Mono large tile, Hide big icons.

templateOptions.name: Tinted tiles
templateOptions.help: Each tile takes a hue derived from the theme's primary color, for launchpads with many destinations. Browsers without relative color syntax keep the primary color.

templateOptions.name: Compact rows
templateOptions.help: Rows of 118px instead of 150px, for launchpads above a report.

templateOptions.name: Mono large tile
templateOptions.help: Large tiles keep the light surface instead of a primary fill.

templateOptions.name: Hide big icons
templateOptions.help: Removes the oversized background icons and keeps the small icon chip, for dense dashboards.
